import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=df, palette='viridis')
sns.stripplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=df, color='gray', alpha=0.3, size=3)
plt.yscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type (Log Scale)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
